translations.ui.d398ae18ddb4: Yana ƙirƙirar zaman uwar garke; ba a ɗauki kowace kiran PSTN ba sai mai samar da sadarwa ya aika tsohuwar zuwa webhook ɗin da aka tsarota.
translations.ui.07ddb7f340fd: IVR: Matsa 1 don matsala, 2 don alƙawari, 3 don wakilin tallafi.
translations.ui.8ef964729e07: Yana ɗaukar tsohon kiran da ke cikin jeri kuma yana ba shi mafi kyawun wakili da ake da shi (dangane da ƙwarewa, sannan wanda ya fi tsayi a jiran aiki). Hukuncin ba da aiki ne kawai — ba yana nufin an samu haɗin waya na gaske ba.
translations.ui.9077c50d8036: ID na Zaman Kira da za a Saki

translations.ui.43db61570404: Taswirar tana amfani da Leaflet da bayanai na kai tsaye /v1/gis/fleet. Ba a ƙirƙiri wuraren motoci ba ta UI.
translations.ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Kyamara da mai binciken yanar gizo suna kama shaida a gida. Koɗinatu suna fitowa ne daga GPS, sannan za a iya tura shaida zuwa uwar garke ta amfani da tikitin da aka amince da shi.
translations.ui.06fa943be019: Matsayi yana da tabbataccen tsari: gaggawar SLA + daidaiton ƙwarewa + nisa + yawan aiki. Uwar garken ita ce ke da iko wajen rarrabawa.
translations.ui.f1a80e3e8395: Wannan ba allon kwalliya ba ne. Jerin da ke ƙasa an gina shi ne daga tushen HTML da aka makala kuma yana rarraba kowace fasali bisa ga hujjojin aiwatarwa a cikin ma'ajiyar ajiya. Sunan fasali ba yana nufin cewa fasalin ya cika ba.
translations.ui.8df329dfaf92: Jimillar adadin fasalolin da aka ambata
translations.ui.1e22c22f5622: Karanta bayanan lissafi daga PostgreSQL kawai. Babu wani Shugaban AI mai cin gashin kansa, babu aiwatar da harkokin kudi mai zaman kansa, kuma babu sakamakon kwaikwayo da aka gabatar a matsayin gaskiya.

translations.ui.ddf413a199e7: Wannan shafin ba ya ƙirƙirar lambobi: idan API/DB ba ta nan, yana nuna yanayin rashin samun dama maimakon bayanan ƙarya.
translations.ui.fe1b878224ed: Aikin fili na gaske: kyamara + OCR + GPS + hujja + rufewa mai iko daga uwar garke. Ba a samar da bayanai na tsoho na GPS/jerin ba.
